title: Differentially Expressed Genes for Atrial Fibrillation Identified using RNA Sequencing from Paired Human Left and Right Atrial Appendages.
tissue_model: human paired left and right atrial appendage, bulk RNA-seq
contrast_description: positive log2FC = higher expression in atrial fibrillation than in sinus rhythm
method: DESeq2 1.50.2 Wald test; pairing pooled: counts summed across each donor's two appendages (20 libraries -> 10 donors), design ~ group, BH adjustment; DESeq2 independent filtering leaves padj NA for filtered genes
pairing_rationale: disease status is donor-level (each donor is AF or SR and contributes both LA and RA), so a donor fixed block is confounded with the contrast; DESeq2 has no random effects; pooling the paired libraries avoids pseudo-replication
description: Full-transcriptome DESeq2 AF-vs-SR differential expression on donor-pooled counts (paired LA+RA appendages summed per donor, 20 libraries -> 10 donors; 5 AF / 5 SR). Positive log2FC = higher in AF.
